gevrey_witness_producer.scope: the universal scalar recurrence and its complete three-parameter value/first/second jets in each chart; metric origin localization is validated separately from the enclosed scalar source

parameter_tuples.vacuum: theta=(h0,kappa,Mbar_infinity) with eta fixed and mu=eta*Mbar_infinity

jet_algebra.reciprocal: construct G=1/F in the same component order by solving (F*G)_0=1, (F*G)_a=0 and (F*G)_ab=0 in value, first, then ordered second order
jet_algebra.division_guard: the value denominator must exclude zero before any reciprocal jet is constructed

lifted_recurrence.formula: U_(n+1)=-(C0(n) odot U_n+C1(n) odot U_(n-1)+C2(n) odot U_(n-2)) odot reciprocal(2*kappa*(n+1))
lifted_recurrence.coefficient_jets: C0,C1,C2 are obtained by exact symbolic differentiation of the recorded universal c0,c1,c2 after the chart parameter substitution
lifted_recurrence.origin_jet: U_0 is the jet of h0: value h0, d_h0=1, every other first and second parameter partial exactly zero
lifted_recurrence.operation_order: coefficient jets, three jet products, exact sum, denominator reciprocal, final product; no midpoint substitution

linear_majorant_matrices.definition: expand the lifted linear recurrence uniquely as U_(n+1)=L0(n)U_n+L1(n)U_(n-1)+L2(n)U_(n-2) in the frozen 13-component order
linear_majorant_matrices.entry_normal_form: each entry is (a2*n^2+a1*n+a0)/(n+1), where a2,a1,a0 are exact rational functions of the compact parameter box and fixed eta on the vacuum chart
linear_majorant_matrices.coefficient_enclosure: enclose every a2,a1,a0 with 512-bit directed balls after proving every kappa denominator strictly excludes zero
linear_majorant_matrices.matrix_majorant: G_s=max_row sum_column (mag(a2)+mag(a1)+mag(a0)) for s=0,1,2; G0,G1,G2 are Gevrey majorants and the predecessor scalar-equation coefficients retain the distinct names P0,P1,P2
linear_majorant_matrices.proved_bound: norm_infinity(L_s(n))<=G_s*(n+1) for every integer n>=0 because n^2/(n+1)<=n+1, n/(n+1)<=1<=n+1 and 1/(n+1)<=1<=n+1

dyadic_rate_selector.candidates: A=2^e in increasing e for e=0..1024
dyadic_rate_selector.selection: first candidate whose directed upper bound satisfies the predicate

base_constant.definition: C=2*max_(j=0,1,2) norm_infinity(U_j)/(A^j*j!) using directed upper bounds
base_constant.proof_step: for n>=2 divide the three majorant terms by C*A^(n+1)*(n+1)!; their ratios are at most G0/A, G1/A^2 and G2/A^3 respectively, whose sum is <=1/2
base_constant.zero_C: allowed only when all three base jets are exact zero; otherwise C must be strictly positive

record_fields: all directed a2,a1,a0 coefficient balls for L0,L1,L2
G0,G1,G2 Gevrey majorants, selected exponent e and A
every denominator margin and resource counter

required_outputs: directed enclosures for scalar Borel state and derivatives
all first and second full-state jets
finite Laplace integral enclosures for required x/q derivative kernels
finite_positive_ray_witness.selection_status: new additive candidate-neutral definition pending independent acknowledgement; implementation remains stopped

producer_witness: exact dyadic T0>0 and exact T=2*T0
exact rational or directed-ball positive-definite matrix P for the explicit scalar base system
directed internal sigma/tau tiers with polynomial degree fixed to zero after absorption
directed scalar value/first/second boundary norms at the LMI onset t=T0 and their absolute-exponential constants, plus metric boundary norms at T=2*T0
directed exponentially weighted finite-history edge constants on [0,T0] for every convolution term and companion tier
verifier_conditions: A_scalar(t,theta)^T*P+P*A_scalar(t,theta)-2*sigma0*P is strictly negative definite for every t>=T0 and every theta in the compact box
the t>=T0 LMI condition is mapped by u=1/t to u in [0,1/T0] and every positive denominator is cleared with its sign proved
inhomogeneous first/second variational forcing is bounded in the matching P norm
all derivative-convolution polynomial prefactors are included

growth_tiers.gap_partition: g is divided into eight exact positive eighths
internal_scalar_definitions: sigma1=2*mu_upper+3*g/8 for scalar first parameter derivatives
sigma2=2*mu_upper+5*g/8 for scalar second parameter derivatives
uses: tau1 for first state derivatives and their forcing
tau2 for second state derivatives and their forcing

tail_augmented_systems_and_growth_closur.symbol_namespace: P_lyap is the accepted 4x4 Lyapunov matrix (displayed as P only inside standard LMI formulas); BP is the scalar momentum Borel component -(kappa+t)*B+(beta+1)*J1; the bare wire/member name P is forbidden

scalar_base_system.tail_domain: t>=T0>=1 with kappa_lower>0; output/Laplace bounds are rebased at T=2*T0
scalar_base_system.parameter_derivatives: A_a and A_ab are exact first/ordered-second derivatives of the displayed matrix in the three-parameter jet algebra

scalar_lyapunov_verifier.construction: at each T0 candidate solve (A_infinity(theta_mid)-sigma0*I)^T*P+P*(A_infinity(theta_mid)-sigma0*I)=-I in directed balls and round the symmetric midpoint to denominator 2^256
scalar_lyapunov_verifier.base_lmi: verify A^T*P+P*A-2*sigma0*P<0 strictly for t>=T0 and the complete parameter box after u=1/t substitution and sign-proved denominator clearing
scalar_lyapunov_verifier.compact_box_enclosure: after u=1/t substitution, clear only denominators whose directed lower bounds are strictly positive, expand every symmetric-matrix entry as a polynomial, and evaluate it by directed multivariate Horner in fixed variable order u,h0,kappa,theta2 over [0,1/T0] times the complete chart parameter box; eta is a fixed coefficient in the vacuum chart; no subdivision or point sampling is permitted
parameter_operator_bounds: verify A_a^T*P*A_a<=K1^2*P for each a with one common directed K1>=0
verify A_ab^T*P*A_ab<=K2^2*P for every ordered a,b with one common directed K2>=0
scalar_lyapunov_verifier.operator_bound_selector: for K1 and then K2 independently test K=2^e in increasing e=0..1024 with the same compact-box enclosure and select the first K making every required K^2*P-A_derivative^T*P*A_derivative strictly positive definite; exhaustion is FAIL
scalar_lyapunov_verifier.p_norm_component_extraction: compute the exact rational inverse Pinv of the accepted rational P_lyap, verify P_lyap*Pinv=I entrywise, prove every diagonal Pinv_ii>0, and set EP=max_i sqrt(Pinv_ii) with 512-bit directed square roots; then abs(y_i)<=EP*norm_(P_lyap)(y) for each ordered component B,V,J1,J2 and for every value/parameter jet
scalar_lyapunov_verifier.matrix_comparison: strict negative/positive definiteness is certified by exact symmetric LDL^T with directed pivots after interval remainder enclosure; any zero-containing pivot, touching or undecidable sign is FAIL

scalar_jet_constants.interval_p_norm_upper: for an interval state box Y in frozen B,V,J1,J2 order set qP=sum_(i=0)^3 sum_(j=0)^3 mag((P_lyap)_ij)*mag(Y_i)*mag(Y_j) outward and normP_upper(Y)=sqrt(qP) outward; invalid, negative or nonfinite qP is FAIL; use this same conservative map for every value/first/ordered-second boundary box
boundary_norms: C0O=max P-norm of the value state at the onset T0
C1O=max P-norm over the three first parameter states at the onset T0
C2O=max P-norm over the nine ordered second parameter states at the onset T0

finite_growth_bound_algebra.bound_type: G_a(C,d,sigma) means abs(F(t))<=C*(1+t)^d*exp(sigma*t) for t>=a>=0, C>=0 and integer d>=0; a is part of every growth-DAG node
finite_growth_bound_algebra.sum: set a=max(aF,aG), lift both inputs to sigma=max(sigmaF,sigmaG) and d=max(dF,dG) on t>=a, then add outward constants
finite_growth_bound_algebra.polynomial_multiplier: multiplication by a recorded polynomial of degree r adds r to d and multiplies C by its directed l1 coefficient majorant because abs(poly(t))<=l1(poly)*(1+t)^r for t>=0
finite_growth_bound_algebra.rational_multiplier: reduce R(t,theta)=N/D exactly, set r=max(0,degree_t(N)-degree_t(D)), prove D excludes zero on t>=a after u=1/t substitution, and compute LR>=sup abs(R(t,theta))/(1+t)^r by the fixed directed multivariate-Horner compact-box enclosure; multiplication by R adds r to d and multiplies C by LR; a nonfinite LR, undecidable denominator or degree above 64 is FAIL
finite_growth_bound_algebra.derivative_convolution_tail_split: for t>=T=2*T0 split integral_0^t into [0,T0], [T0,t-T0], [t-T0,t]; the left and right edge integrals use recorded finite-history L1 bounds with one tail factor, while the middle interval uses both tail bounds
finite_growth_bound_algebra.finite_history_constants: H_(F|sigmaG)=integral_0^T0 abs(F(s))*exp(-sigmaG*s)ds and H_(Gprime|sigmaF)=integral_0^T0 abs(G'(s))*exp(-sigmaF*s)ds are directed panel sums and are recorded for every value/parameter jet and every applicable companion tier
finite_growth_bound_algebra.finite_history_panel_algorithm: on each accepted panel s=sL+xi, xi in [0,h], write the retained Taylor model as sum_k p_k*xi^k plus uniform remainder R; bound the weighted absolute integral by sum_k mag(p_k)*exp(-sigma*sL)*integral_0^h xi^k*exp(-sigma*xi)dxi + mag(R)*exp(-sigma*sL)*integral_0^h exp(-sigma*xi)dxi, using directed incomplete-gamma moments for sigma>0 and exact h^(k+1)/(k+1) moments for sigma=0; sum panels in increasing chronology without cancellation
finite_growth_bound_algebra.derivative_convolution: if F has G_T0(CF,dF,sigmaF) and Gprime has G_T0(CGprime,dGprime,sigmaG), then on t>=T the boundary has (CF*abs(G(0)),dF,sigmaF), the left edge has (CGprime*H_(F|sigmaG),dGprime,sigmaG), the right edge has (CF*H_(Gprime|sigmaF),dF,sigmaF), and the middle has (CF*CGprime,dF+dGprime+1,max(sigmaF,sigmaG)); lift and sum all four outward
finite_growth_bound_algebra.parameter_variations: apply the exact base/first/second convolution identities first, then the same bound algebra term by term

polynomial_to_exponential_absorption.value_target: absorb every scalar-value source from sigma<=sigma0 into tau0 using epsilon>=tau0-sigma0=g/8
polynomial_to_exponential_absorption.first_target: absorb every first-parameter source from sigma<=sigma1 into tau1 using epsilon>=tau1-sigma1=g/8
polynomial_to_exponential_absorption.second_target: absorb every second-parameter source from sigma<=sigma2 into tau2 using epsilon>=tau2-sigma2=g/8

analytic_and_scalar_derived_inputs.E1: exp(2*mu*t) is lifted from type 2*mu to the applicable internal sigma with absolute-exponential constant 1
chart_coefficient_parameter_jets: eta has exact zero first and second parameter jets
analytic_and_scalar_derived_inputs.vacuum_mu_chain: for theta2=Mbar_infinity, mu=eta*theta2, so X_theta2=eta*X_mu and X_theta2theta2=eta^2*X_mumu for X in F,E1,E2; all kappa/mu mixed partials of these X are exact zero before source products
analytic_and_scalar_derived_inputs.analytic_jet_growth: apply the fixed polynomial multiplier and absorption rules to every displayed t or t^2/t^3 factor before source convolution; missing either mixed orientation or any analytic-factor jet is FAIL
analytic_and_scalar_derived_inputs.H: B component of the scalar state
analytic_and_scalar_derived_inputs.component_ingress: convert every B,V,J1,J2 value/first/second P-norm bound to a component bound with the recorded EP before evaluating any source expression
analytic_and_scalar_derived_inputs.K: B'+t*B'' is V+t*row_2(A_scalar)*y; expand this exact row expression after EP component extraction and bound every rational/polynomial coefficient with the growth algebra before absorption
analytic_and_scalar_derived_inputs.BP: -(kappa+t)*B+(beta+1)*J1 bounded by the growth algebra before absorption
analytic_and_scalar_derived_inputs.orientation_rule: use the displayed orientation in finite Volterra panels, weighted edge histories and tail growth; swapping operands, differentiating a different operand or using a pointwise product is FAIL
analytic_and_scalar_derived_inputs.sources: H2,P2,BRD,BRS and all parameter variations follow the exact metric-Borel expression DAG and derivative-convolution rules

metric_integral_systems.verifier: prove mD<=rhoM and mS<=rhoM for t>=T=2*T0 and the full parameter box after u=1/t substitution; prove q<=qT=1/(T+2*kappa_lower)
metric_integral_systems.parameter_bounds: derive common nonnegative KM0 for abs(mD),abs(mS), KM1 for every first parameter derivative of mD,mS,q, and KM2 for every ordered-second parameter derivative of mD,mS,q on the compact tail box
metric_integral_systems.parameter_bound_selector: for KM0, KM1 and KM2 independently test K=2^e in increasing e=0..1024 and select the first K whose directed multivariate-Horner enclosure proves abs(mD),abs(mS)<=KM0, abs(first derivative)<=KM1, or abs(ordered-second derivative)<=KM2 on u in [0,1/T] and the complete chart parameter box; exhaustion is FAIL
metric_integral_systems.boundary_constants: CMT0=exp(-tau0*T)*max norm of JD,JS at T; CMT1=exp(-tau1*T)*max first-jet norm at T; CMT2=exp(-tau2*T)*max ordered-second-jet norm at T
metric_integral_systems.outputs: BD=JD' and BS=JS' are bounded by CBM0,CBM1,CBM2 at tau0,tau1,tau2 respectively; every displayed product is accumulated outward before absorption

tail_record: T0,T,P_lyap,Pinv,EP,each onset interval box qP and normP_upper,K1 exponent,K1,K2 exponent,K2,C0O,C1O,C2O,D0,D1,D2,C0,C1,C2,C0T,C1T,C2T

every analytic-factor value/first/ordered-second jet, every growth DAG node orientation,onset a,C,d,sigma, every rational multiplier r,LR, every weighted finite-history panel contribution and total, and every absorption constant
all compact-u denominator, LDL^T and first-failure evidence

assumption: a matching bound is available for at least one derivative used in the boundary-plus-integral form
derivative_convolution_growth.split_domain: for t>=T=2*T0 use [0,T0], [T0,t-T0], [t-T0,t] so every tail operand is evaluated at an argument >=T0
derivative_convolution_growth.weighted_edges: record integral_0^T0 abs(F(s))*exp(-sigmaG*s)ds and integral_0^T0 abs(G'(s))*exp(-sigmaF*s)ds; unweighted histories or evaluation of a growing tail at t-T0 are invalid
derivative_convolution_growth.conclusion: the derivative-convolution has exponential type max(sigmaF,sigmaG) and a directed polynomial prefactor of finite recorded degree on t>=T

laplace_tail_bound.assumption: abs(F(t))<=C*(1+t)^p*exp(tau*t) for t>=T, integer p>=0, tau<=tau2<255
laplace_tail_bound.uniform_ratio_bound: y/a^m<=255/delta^m for every integer m>=1 and y>=255
laplace_tail_bound.endpoint_x_zero: insert the exact formal endpoint value; never evaluate 1/x

coordinate_derivative_laplace_kernels.scope: x denotes q or Q; the identical formulas apply to every value, first-state-jet and second-state-jet Borel component
coordinate_derivative_laplace_kernels.required_coordinate_orders: j=0..12 in increasing order; rows are generated with exact signed integers
coordinate_derivative_laplace_kernels.tail_moment_term: for a=y-tau and s=m+k-l+1, y^r*integral_T^infinity t^(m+k)*exp(-a*t)dt <= ((m+k)!/l!)*T^l*U_(r,s) after summing l=0..m+k

Phi_d(delta,T): exp(-z*T)*z^d for integer d>0 and z=max(delta,d/T)
uniform_exponential_power_majorant.proof_route: write y^r=(a+tau)^r, use 0<=tau<=tau2 and maximize exp(-a*T)*a^(z-s) over a>=delta
uniform_exponential_power_majorant.outward_evaluation: tau2,delta,T, every power, maximum and exponential are directed; a nonpositive delta or T is FAIL

coordinate_derivative_laplace_kernels.endpoint_x_zero: insert d_x^j L_F(0)=j!*f_j exactly when the exponential-generating Borel input is F(t)=sum_(n>=0) f_n*t^n/n!; never evaluate y or 1/x
coordinate_derivative_laplace_kernels.state_derivative_rule: state differentiation commutes with the directed integral only after the matching value/first/second Borel growth witness has passed; apply the same j=0..12 kernels to F_i and F_ij
coordinate_derivative_laplace_kernels.coefficient_space_use: the j=0..12 bounds feed the frozen theta-pullback Bell-12 coefficient-tail theorem; j=0..2 also feed the order-8 to order-6 to order-4 residual derivative losses

all_orders_borel_laplace_realization.scope: every positive/vacuum H,K,D,S value, ordered first parameter jet and ordered second parameter jet after its positive-ray continuation and matching growth witness pass
all_orders_borel_laplace_realization.local_egf_remainder: if F(t)=sum_n f_n*t^n/n! and abs(f_n)<=C*A^n*n!, then for A*t0<=1/4 and every integer N>=0, abs(F(t)-sum_(n=0)^(N-1) f_n*t^n/n!)<=C*(A*t)^N/(1-A*t0) on 0<=t<=t0
all_orders_borel_laplace_realization.local_laplace_remainder: the positive-kernel integral of the local EGF remainder is <=C*A^N*N!*x^N/(1-A*t0)
all_orders_borel_laplace_realization.far_ray_flatness: subtract the same finite EGF polynomial on t>=t0; the recorded polynomial-exponential bounds for F and that polynomial reduce every far-ray term to y^r*exp(-(y-tau)*t0); for y>=max(255,2*tau), use y-tau>=y/2 and exp(-z)<=L!/z^L with L=N+r to obtain an explicit directed constant times x^N for every N
all_orders_borel_laplace_realization.cinfinity_endpoint: therefore L_F(x)=x^-1*integral_0^infinity exp(-t/x)*F(t)dt for x>0 has the unique C-infinity extension at x=0 with d_x^j L_F(0)=j!*f_j for every integer j>=0
all_orders_borel_laplace_realization.parameter_interchange: apply the same local and far-ray estimates to every recorded first/ordered-second parameter jet; only after those uniform witnesses pass may parameter differentiation commute with the Laplace integral
all_orders_borel_laplace_realization.product_homomorphism: the absolute growth margins and weighted edge bounds justify Fubini and integration by parts, yielding L_(F diamond G)(x)=L_F(x)*L_G(x) for every 0<x<=1/255 with the displayed frozen derivative-convolution orientation
all_orders_borel_laplace_realization.equation_replay: replay the universal-scalar and metric-Borel transform tables symbolically; after applying the Laplace map, require exact-zero positive/vacuum H,K,D,S formal-subsystem residuals and exact-zero first/ordered-second parameter variations before any flat-remainder assembly

finite_positive_ray_algorithm.component_scope: scalar Borel state (B,V,J1,J2), metric integral states JD/JS, four realized formal components H,K,D,S, and the complete three-parameter value/first/second jet inventory in each chart
finite_positive_ray_algorithm.compressed_jet_binding: use borel-state-jet-system v1 compressed_parameter_jet_realization: 1 value + 3 ordered first parameter partials + 9 ordered second parameter partials per Borel component, followed by exact full-state composition

origin_localization.gevrey_input: a proved outward Gevrey witness abs(f_n)<=C*A^n*n! for every required parameter partial
origin_localization.start_point: t0 is the largest positive dyadic not exceeding min(1/4,1/(4*A_upper))
origin_localization.borel_derivative_tails: for m=0,1,2 define DTail(m,r,z)=d^m/dz^m[z^(r+1)/(1-z)]; then abs(sum_(n>r) f_n*t^(n-m)/(n-m)!)<=C*A_upper^m*DTail(m,r,A_upper*t), omitting n<m; evaluate the displayed rational derivative exactly with directed z in [0,A_upper*t0]
origin_localization.integral_state_tails: for z=A_upper*t and n>r, J1 tail <=C*t*z^(r+1)/((r+2)*(1-z)) and J2 tail <=C*t^2*z^(r+1)/((r+2)*(r+3)*(1-z)); use the same formulas for every parameter jet
origin_localization.selector: use the first listed order whose directed B,V,J1,J2 value/derivative tails and origin compatibility enclose every required component within the fixed numerical-width rule; exhaustion is FAIL
origin_localization.zero_endpoint: all endpoint values and coordinate derivatives are inserted from exact recurrence coefficients

positive_panel_continuation.representation: piecewise Taylor models in t with exact-power-series coefficient algebra and directed remainder balls
positive_panel_continuation.panel_width: at each left endpoint tL>0 choose the largest dyadic h not exceeding min(tL/4,(tL+2*kappa_lower)/4,T-tL); if validation fails, halve h before trying a later T
positive_panel_continuation.selector: for a fixed panel use the first listed order passing the exact defect and interval-Picard inclusion; if no order passes, halve the panel; never change equations or tolerances
positive_panel_continuation.validation: apply validated_picard_enclosure to the exact rational first-order Borel equations and all ordered parameter variations over the full panel; require its strict componentwise self-inclusion and the numerical-width rule
positive_panel_continuation.singular_denominators: prove t>0, t+2*kappa>0 and every cleared denominator sign on every panel; touching or undecidable is FAIL
positive_panel_continuation.chronology: panels are accepted strictly left-to-right and no later panel is evaluated after the first failure

derivative_convolution_panels.target_panel: t=tC+xi with xi in [-h/2,h/2] on one accepted scalar target panel; u is divided into P equal dyadic subpanels in increasing ordinal order
derivative_convolution_panels.operand_model_selection: for each (xi,u) rectangle, enumerate every accepted source panel intersected by t*u or t*(1-u), translate each intersected Taylor model to the exact affine image, and hull all models; no midpoint panel choice is allowed
derivative_convolution_panels.polynomial_order: rC=min(r_target,r_F,r_Gprime) in the accepted order schedule; compose and multiply exact bivariate polynomials, retain every xi degree <=rC, and move every discarded higher-xi term to the remainder
derivative_convolution_panels.exact_u_integration: integrate every retained rational/directed-ball u monomial exactly over its dyadic u subpanel and sum subpanels in increasing order; multiply the result by the full t=tC+xi polynomial Jacobian
derivative_convolution_panels.remainder_cross_terms: on every rectangle add mag(PF)*RG+mag(PGprime)*RF+RF*RG plus the directed discarded-polynomial tail, affine-composition remainder and source-panel hull radius; all are integrated against the positive u width without cancellation
derivative_convolution_panels.selector: use the first P candidate for which every output Taylor coefficient/remainder passes the fixed numerical-width rule; on exhaustion reject the current target panel so the outer panel rule halves h; if h-halving exhausts, FAIL
derivative_convolution_panels.history_and_diagonal: the same u rule covers origin history, all prior panels and the current diagonal; F(t)*G(0), the Jacobian t, u=0 and u=1 endpoint balls are retained exactly
derivative_convolution_panels.state_jets: apply the exact base/first/second derivative-convolution rules before interval projection; both mixed Hessian orientations are explicit

metric_continuation.method: after scalar/source panel enclosure, solve JD'=(BRD+(2*beta+3)*JD)/(2*kappa+t) and JS'=(BRS+(2*beta+2)*JS)/(2*kappa+t) with the identical Taylor/Picard panel rule; set BD=JD' and BS=JS'
metric_continuation.origin_values: use the chart-specific exact BRD(0),BRS(0),JD(0)=JS(0)=0 normalizations
metric_continuation.parameter_variations: differentiate the unsolved metric equations first and retain every denominator, beta, source and integral-state term

tail_split_selector.laplace_split: T=2*T0, so T ranges from 2 through 8192
tail_split_selector.rule: use the first T0 candidate for which the t>=T0 LMI and K1/K2 selectors verify, finite continuation succeeds through T=2*T0, scalar onset constants and every weighted edge history verify at T0, and every value/first/second realized and metric forcing witness verifies at T; a failed T0 is internal witness discovery inside the one bounded algorithm, not a retry of candidate execution
chronology: visit T0 candidates in listed order and record every rejected witness reason
test parameter margins, construct P and test the compact-box LMI plus K1/K2 before requesting any new finite panel

after a tail predicate first passes, extend the accepted finite panel ledger append-only through T=2*T0; reuse all earlier panels byte-for-byte and never recompute an accepted endpoint, order, remainder or convolution enclosure
a finite origin, panel, Picard, convolution or fixed-resource failure is terminal at its producer failure code and no later T0 is visited
a finite continuation success followed by a tail/growth witness rejection may advance to the next T0 and extend the same append-only ledger
select the first T0 for which every displayed predicate and record field passes
tail_split_selector.failure_mapping: if all T0 candidates are rejected by tail/growth predicates, emit C08-011_TAIL_SPLIT_EXHAUSTION with the ordered child-reason ledger; C08-012_LYAPUNOV_OR_OPERATOR_BOUND is reserved for corruption or independent replay failure of the selected P,LMI,K1,K2,KM0,KM1,KM2 witness; resource failures remain at their originating earlier producer code
tail_split_selector.lyapunov_construction: solve the shifted asymptotic Lyapunov equation in directed balls, round the midpoint matrix entrywise to denominator 2^256, then verify positive definiteness and the exact compact-u tail LMI; discovery has no authority without verifier replay

finite_positive_ray_algorithm.fixed_numerical_width_rule: for every stored finite-continuation or finite-projection ball z, rad(z)<=2^-180*max(1,mag(z)); this controls implementation enclosure width and does not replace any scientific threshold

validated_picard_enclosure.scope: every scalar and metric value/parameter-jet Taylor panel after all required source Taylor models are available
validated_picard_enclosure.panel_coordinate: xi=t-tL in [0,h] with exact dyadic tL,h and component weights all exactly one
validated_picard_enclosure.polynomial_construction: p(xi)=sum_(k=0)^r p_k*xi^k; p_0 is the complete left-end ball and p_(k+1) is obtained in increasing k by exact truncated power-series substitution into z'=F(t,z)
validated_picard_enclosure.defect: d(xi)=p'(xi)-F(tL+xi,p(xi)); coefficients 0..r-1 are replayed and must contain exact zero, while the complete interval range supplies component magnitudes D_i>=sup(abs(d_i))
validated_picard_enclosure.correction_operator: T(E)(xi)=integral_0^xi (F(tL+s,p(s)+E(s))-p'(s))ds with E(0)=0; evaluate F over the full parameter box, panel and candidate symmetric component box
validated_picard_enclosure.exact_zero_defect: if every D_i is exact zero, accept the exact zero remainder only after replaying the full ODE identity and denominator guards
validated_picard_enclosure.inflation_candidates: lambda=2^j in increasing j for j=1..16
validated_picard_enclosure.candidate_box: set Dmax=max_i D_i; unless every D_i is exact zero, E_lambda gives every component the common symmetric radius lambda*h*Dmax so coupled zero-defect components can receive a nonzero Picard image; the all-exact-zero case follows exact_zero_defect
validated_picard_enclosure.acceptance: the interval range of every component of T(E_lambda) is a strict subset of the corresponding symmetric E_lambda interval; equality, touching, nonfinite or undecidable containment rejects that lambda
validated_picard_enclosure.selection: use the first accepted lambda; if none passes, reject the current Taylor order, then follow the fixed later-order and panel-halving chronology
validated_picard_enclosure.stored_remainder: store the accepted componentwise E_lambda plus the complete defect, denominator, lambda, order, h and strict-containment margins
validated_picard_enclosure.numerical_width: the polynomial range plus accepted remainder must satisfy the fixed numerical-width rule
validated_picard_enclosure.first_failure: denominator, nonfinite coefficient, defect replay, exact-zero replay, inflation containment, numerical width, order exhaustion, panel-halving exhaustion

inner_finite_integrals.scope: for every accepted Taylor panel, every coordinate kernel moment m=0..12 and every value/parameter-jet component
inner_finite_integrals.method: integrate each panel Taylor polynomial times t^m*exp(-y*t) with directed incomplete-gamma moment identities; bound the Taylor remainder by its uniform panel ball times the exact positive kernel integral
inner_finite_integrals.endpoint: x=0 uses exact recurrence coefficients and performs no y or exponential evaluation
inner_finite_integrals.tail: t>=T uses the applicable value/first/second growth tier and coordinate_derivative_laplace_kernels bound
inner_finite_integrals.cancellation: signed polynomial contributions may be accumulated as balls; remainder magnitudes and separate coordinate-kernel terms are summed without cancellation

outer_chebyshev_projection.map: x(theta)=(1-cos(theta))/510 on theta in [0,pi], with x=q or Q
outer_chebyshev_projection.coefficients: c0=pi^-1*integral_0^pi g(theta)dtheta and ck=2*pi^-1*integral_0^pi g(theta)cos(k*theta)dtheta for 1<=k<N
outer_chebyshev_projection.rule: composite six-node Gauss-Legendre on equal dyadic theta panels
outer_chebyshev_projection.order_six_error: for panel width h and an outward bound B12 on the twelfth derivative of the complete integrand, error<=B12*h^13*(6!)^4/(13*(12!)^3)
outer_chebyshev_projection.selector: use the first panel count for which every projected coefficient and parameter jet passes the fixed numerical-width rule after inner-integral and outer-remainder accumulation; exhaustion is FAIL
outer_chebyshev_projection.integrand_derivative_bound: use exact Leibniz through order 12, the coordinate derivative kernels, exact q(theta) derivatives and abs(d_theta^r cos(k*theta))<=k^r; omit no mixed term
outer_chebyshev_projection.node_weight_arithmetic: derive GL6 nodes and positive weights from the exact degree-6 Legendre polynomial with 512-bit directed root isolation; verify symmetry, ordering, positivity and exact moments degree 0..11

coefficient_tail.B_theta_12: outward supremum of the complete realized component's twelfth theta derivative, separately for every value and parameter jet
coefficient_tail.finite_projection_indices: k=0..N-1 in increasing canonical Chebyshev order
coefficient_tail.realized_weighted_norm: sum_(k=0)^(N-1) (1+k)^8*abs(c_k)+Tail8(N), with every finite projection error included inside c_k
coefficient_tail.state_jet_rule: compute the same separate Tail8(N) for every ordered value, first-parameter and second-parameter realized component before full-state composition
coefficient_tail.flat_remainder_use: subtract the realized formal coefficient balls from the full-state coefficient balls, retain both infinite coefficient-tail envelopes, compose full-state jets, then assemble F_flat into Y,Z1,Z2

fixed_resource_bounds.resource_exhaustion: FAIL at the first exhausted counter; no second invocation, alternate root, tolerance change or retune

endpoint_observable_ingress.functional: h0=H(0) or Hbar(0), the q=0 or Q=0 endpoint value of the full factored scalar function
endpoint_observable_ingress.positive_finite_indices: tail_H coefficients have flat indices 6*N+k for k=0..N-1 in the positive state of length 8*N+2
endpoint_observable_ingress.vacuum_finite_indices: tail_Hbar coefficients have flat indices 6*N+k for k=0..N-1 in the vacuum state of length 8*N+1
endpoint_observable_ingress.finite_gradient: d_h0/d_state_i=1 for 6*N<=i<7*N and 0 for every other finite flat index
endpoint_observable_ingress.finite_hessian: d2_h0/d_state_i_d_state_j=0 for every ordered finite index pair
endpoint_observable_ingress.infinite_tail_input: r_infinity is the directed endpoint image of the terminal Banach tail ball, centered as supplied by the validated terminal-ball record; its absolute radius is bounded by the order-8 tail norm because endpoint evaluation has operator norm at most one
endpoint_observable_ingress.full_banach_derivative: the endpoint functional acts with coefficient 1 on every finite and infinite H/Hbar Chebyshev direction; Z1/Z2 operator bounds retain the infinite-tail norm-one contribution rather than truncating it to the finite gradient
endpoint_observable_ingress.parameter_jet_origin: internal theta differentiation treats h0 as the first independent parameter, with d_h0=1 and zero second theta derivatives; full-state composition then uses the displayed finite and infinite functional
endpoint_observable_ingress.h1: derived from 2*kappa*h1+P0(0)*h0=0 after strict kappa verification; never ingressed independently
endpoint_observable_ingress.strictness: h0 must be finite and its lower endpoint strictly positive; missing/nonfinite tail image, wrong index range, state length mismatch or a touching h0 lower endpoint is FAIL
